title: Tish cho'tkasida kamera (Dyson CameraJet)
caption: 🔍 Tish cho'tkasi ichida kamera bor. Jiddiy. Dyson yangi CameraJet ni taqdim etdi: tish cho'tkasiga mitti makrokamera o'rnatilgan. U sekundiga 28 ta surat oladi, sun'iy intellekt tishlar orasidagi bo'shliqni topadi va aynan o'sha joyga og'iz chayish suyuqligini ingichka oqim bilan yuboradi. Tasvir telefondagi ilovaga uzatiladi, suratlar saqlanmaydi. 💵 E'lon qilingan narxi: $499 📦 Toshkentgacha qancha • Tovar — $499 • AQShdan yetkazish — ~$10 • Yagona bojxona to'lovi — (499 − 200) × 30 % = $89.70 • Jami ≈ 7 064 000 so'm ✅ Olib kirish mumkinmi? Ha — taqiqlangan va ruxsatnoma talab qilinadigan ro'yxatlarda yo'q. Faqat normadan ortiq qism uchun to'lanadi. ⏳ 2027-yil yanvaridan stavka 20 %: to'lov $59.80, ya'ni ≈ 353 000 so'm arzon. Sizningcha, tish cho'tkasiga kamera kerakmi? 👇 📄 Asos: PF-174, 27.08.2026; PQ-4508, 3-band — lex.uz ➖➖➖ @Pochtachi_shopo #topilma
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#topilma".
2) Center: a sleek futuristic electric toothbrush in matte silver and indigo standing upright, with a tiny glowing camera lens near the brush head and a thin sparkling water jet; a small smartphone beside it shows an abstract close-up view. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of aqua (#22D3EE); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Tish cho'tkasida kamera"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Bunday narsa borligini bilarmidingiz?"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtachi_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
